notes.title: Patch notes v0.6921

Steam Achievements! - We’ve added 29 brand-new Steam Achievements - and this is just the beginning! Can you unlock them all?

notes.title: TactiCon Update - Part 1
notes.notes:
TactiCon Update - Part 1
Hi, We're happy to share with you our second Early Access update! You'll find new content, some Quality-of-Life changes, and upcoming content! Enjoy :-)


Patch NoteAdded
Save/Load System – Finally Here!

 You can now save and load your progress at any point in the Story Campaign. This long-awaited feature replaces the old checkpoint system, offering much more flexibility and control.

New Game Mode – Survival: Challenge

Test your endurance in a wave-based survival mode, where each wave features unique enemies. We've added 20 handcrafted waves—how long can you last?
 (Note: The original Survival mode is now renamed to Endless.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/0267be447a0d4dc2b2c50587c7e95dc8da0d1521.png"]

New Multiplayer & Skirmish Maps: Crab Claws

 One brand-new map is available! Brighter, more visually striking, and packed with tight rooms, chokepoints, and creative strategy opportunities.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/3b99f2f9d140c87b8273901dcc9771076dd510a6.png"]
Improved
Weapon balancing tweaks (attack power, range, detection, etc.)

Additional localization fixes on the win/lose screen
Coming Very Soon
 Two major features are just around the corner and will arrive in the next patch:

Steam Achievements 

Multiplayer: Turtle Mode

Custom Key Bindings

1 New Multiplayer & Skirmish Map

Stay tuned! We're preparing great features for the next patch. Please don't hesitate to leave a review or provide feedback; it's greatly appreciated. Thanks!

Join the Discord!

notes.title: Spring Update - June 2025
notes.notes:
Spring Update - June 2025
We're starting summer with our first Early Access update! You'll find new content, some Quality-of-Life changes, and fixes! Enjoy :-)



We’re excited to announce a long-awaited feature — you can now choose from five difficulty levels for each campaign mission! Whether you’re looking for a more relaxed experience or a real challenge, you can tailor the gameplay to suit your style. And that’s just the beginning — in the future, we plan to enhance this feature with additional elements, such as:

Stars are awarded based on the difficulty level you complete a mission on

Dynamic gameplay elements that adjust depending on the chosen difficulty

And more surprises to come!

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4a1.png"] Tip for casual players:  If you find the current camera movement with the middle mouse button uncomfortable, head over to the settings and turn off the “Competitive RTS mouse scrolling” option for an alternative control style.


Patch NoteAdded
Multiplayer Menu: Added a title to the multiplayer menu (localized in all languages).

Difficulty Levels
Improved
Level 3 Diving Creature & Level 5 Starfish: These creatures no longer push the player aggressively. Their behavior now provides a more enjoyable and balanced fight.

Submerge Mechanic: Submerging now takes the player slightly deeper into the water.

Level 1 Ending: Changed the heart color on the ending screen from blue to purple :-)
Fixed
Multiplayer:

Fixed submerge functionality in multiplayer.

Fixed brain boost functionality in multiplayer.

Fixed errors in multiplayer lobby.

Localization/Text:

Fixed the look of the pause menu in all languages.

Fixed alert messages in Chinese so they behave correctly and no longer get stuck on screen.

Localized the alert: "You cannot eat. Requires 'Mouth' organ to harvest resource plants."

Fixed the appearance of win/lose screens across all languages, game modes, and levels.

Fixed HUD appearance in all languages.

Fixed HUD nutrient counters to correctly support more than 999 nutrients of each type.

World map localization fixes.

Fixed localization in Arena and Survival menus.

All game mode titles are now correctly localized in all languages.

Fixed incorrect English text in Arena mode.



The Save & Load system, initially planned in June according to the roadmap, will be postponed to the July update. We are sorry for the inconvenience. We hope you will like this update!

                 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/c8c663bd283bec1bb1edfe5b31d6fabf594fea33.jpg"]

notes.title: Patch notes v0.6911
notes.notes:
Added

Control & Player Guides: Updated the Control Guide and Player Guide, now fully localized in all supported languages! You can access them via the Esc menu during gameplay.

Improved

Level 2: Added more clues to help players discover a secret room near the end of Level 2.
Level 2: Tweaked the end of Level 2 to make the objective clearer and help players progress more intuitively.

Fixed

Heart death asset bug: Destroying a Heart no longer leaves behind a strange donut-shaped creature 
Harvester healing bug Fixed a bug where Harvesters could deliver acid or healing nutrients to the Heart, preventing construction. The Heart now only accepts regular purple nutrients as intended.
Localization issues: Resolved multiple localization issues.
Level 5: Fixed a progression bug in Level 5 where players could skip certain objectives and prematurely attack the mid-level coral barricade. Progression is now locked behind completing the intended objectives!
Tooltips fixed: Tooltips for Tiles/Organs no longer linger on screen when transitioning into cutscenes.
Cave of Wonders audio bug Fixed an audio bug in the Cave of Wonders map (Multiplayer/Skirmish).

notes.title: Early Access release date and our Dev blog!
notes.notes:
The wait is over, Moduwar has an official release date for Early Access: June 3rd,2025

After so many years together, we can finally announce to you: Moduwar will be officially out in Early Access on June 3rd,2025, on Steam! This is a significant step forward for our team, we are finally releasing our dream game soon. But early access does not mean that we have finished the development of our game; it still needs improvement and work. We look forward to your feedback!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/3cdbda4c8397a20115a293a9eb69d8888b847f65.png

Moduwar dev update 
I can’t quite put into words what it feels like to reach the finish line—well, Early Access—for a game you’ve been working on for nearly a decade. But it’s finally happening, and I’m feeling the full spectrum of emotions. In the next update, I want to take you behind the scenes and share everything we've been working on in these final months leading up to release. And believe me, it’s a lot. It honestly feels like a year’s worth of work packed into just four months - Alon Kaplan 

Campaign Deep Dive
In the single-player campaign, we already had three levels in a relatively polished state, but recently, we wrapped up work on Level 3, which we’ve been pouring a lot of effort into.
This level marks a major turning point: it's the first time players will encounter the enemy spaceships of Moduwar’s main antagonists—the ruthless Chimera.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/9aa07815dc59e2c196a3f3e2f06c9a015a000316.jpgChimera spaceships

Level 3 also introduces two brand-new creatures:

 Mogar – a fearsome boss that’s as terrifying as it is powerful.
 The Spitter - a mysterious new monster that still doesn’t have an official name—because the Reddit post we shared asking for name ideas absolutely blew up! With so many amazing suggestions, we’re still narrowing it down.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/7519fcbfcc36e327c482da491588600e2feee0be.jpg
Mogar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/bd9571be76eeead954529bfe7a7bcec1f1a5e9ff.png
Spitter
This level also contains hidden clues about the history of the humans who once explored the planet—uncovering fragments of their past missions and intentions.
You'll also get your first glimpse into the mysterious Free Modu, a unique faction whose story will unfold further as you progress through the game.

Live Action Cutscenes
Another major thing we’re working on right now is the production of live-action cutscenes—complete with actors, extras, and an absolutely wild spaceship bridge set. For us, this is a dream come true. It’s our tribute to the classic RTS games we grew up loving, the ones that inspired us to make Moduwar in the first place. These cutscenes will tell the overarching story of Moduwar and finally give players a glimpse into the world we’ve been imagining and building for years.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/6234722b3d8b1c932243c40ab0764104faceda2f.jpg
Spaceships

New Features & Improvements
We’ve made major improvements to the merging system, making it far more intuitive and user-friendly. One big upgrade: you’ll now see visual arrows indicating exactly where the merge will happen—so no more guessing or misplacing your units mid-battle.
(Yes, we know the arrows are currently red... that’s just a placeholder—for now! 😄)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/abb977e3f5fd83effd619469015939cc8492e1ac.gif
Merging tool

Introducing Large Organs!

Last year, we introduced a powerful new mechanic: the ability to combine three turrets into one massive Turret Organ. Now, we’ve expanded that idea across the entire game. Every organ in Moduwar can now be combined into a large organ—some are simply stronger versions of their original form, while others unlock special abilities that can dramatically shift the course of battle.
Discovering what each one does is part of the fun... if you can manage to build them. 😉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/1440ce088c3ede17b77620bd4af47deaed5da3f4.png
Turret Organ

World Map Upgrade!
We’ve finally overhauled Moduwar’s world map with smooth animations and detailed level information.
Each mission now comes with a short introduction, giving players helpful context and a taste of the story before diving in.
It’s not just a map anymore—it’s the start of your journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/c1632234879ea4a4a89903958d758a1705181d8c.png
World Map

Main Menu Visual Updates
Our main menu has received a fresh visual upgrade—complete with new graphics, animations, and of course, our new publisher’s logo: FireSquid! 🐙

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/f87d4b0b0651a5476e2e34fcfa1a45b9cf8d559f.gif
Main Menu

One Last Thing…Localization
Just yesterday, we sent the entire game's text off for localization, and Moduwar will soon be available in 6–8 additional languages alongside English. This is a big milestone for us—we're excited to bring the world of Modu to even more players around the globe!
 There’s still a ton happening behind the scenes, and even more exciting features on the horizon. We’re fully focused on wrapping up the Early Access version—and already looking ahead to the next big update.

Thank you all for the incredible support so far; none of this would be possible without our amazing community. We will continue to improve our game and make it perfect for you to play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/f5587fa419d5105228d86f0544713ccd52f041fe.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33612624/b179de58911c3ae80270f461b7fb392936338a70.png
